title: Annual report.
bodyText: The ombudsman shall submit to the legislature and the public an annual report discussing the ombudsman's activities under this chapter.
bodyHtml: §96-16  Annual report.  The ombudsman shall submit to the legislature and the public an annual report discussing the ombudsman's activities under this chapter. [L 1967, c 306, §17; HRS §96-16; gen ch 1985]
